zh.title: 美軍獲4.72億美元合約升級契努克直升機隊服役至2040年代
zh.summary: 美國陸軍推動4.72億美元合約，升級契努克直升機隊並延長服役至2040年代。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月的報導，美國陸軍正致力於推動一項價值 4.72 億美元的機隊升級合約，針對旗下的契努克（Chinook）直升機進行升級作業。這款直升機最早始於 1960 年代，本次合約將有效延伸該機隊的服役壽限。
由於目前短期內尚無預計問世的替代機種，美國陸軍正透過這項計畫對契努克直升機隊進行升級作業。該項升級工程旨在維持機隊服役狀態，確保直升機動能可繼續飛行並服役至 2040 年代。

en.title: US Army Upgrades Chinook Fleet Under $472 Million Contract To Fly Into 2040s
en.summary: US Army executes $472 million contract to upgrade Chinook fleet and extend service into 2040s.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying in August 2026, the US Army is currently working to upgrade its fleet of Chinook helicopters under a $472 million contract. The modernization effort seeks to extend the operational capability of the aircraft model, which originally dates back to the 1960s.

With no immediate replacement coming any time soon for the platform, the US Army is proceeding with the fleet upgrade program. This initiative is designed to extend the service life of the Chinook fleet, allowing the helicopters to continue flying into the 2040s.
